description_en: Queries the details of a sound code schedule
description_zh: 调用该接口查询声码排程详情
kebab_example: aliyun iot get-sound-code-schedule --schedule-code Md3ZiTL888K9llXDy789000000000000 --iot-instance-id iot-v6400000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSoundCodeSchedule

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the schedule
parameters.name: schedule_code

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this **ID** value is available, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id
